activities.description: Al Harrison is sitting at his desk reading a document.
Paul Stafford stands behind him with his arms crossed.
Al Harrison stands up and confronts Katherine Goble about the Atlas rocket.
Katherine Goble explains she held the document up to the light to see the classified information.
Al Harrison confirms the document contains classified information about the Atlas rocket.
Al Harrison questions Katherine Goble and learns she is not a Russian spy.
Al Harrison directs Paul Stafford to give Katherine Goble access to unredacted information about the Shepard trajectories.
Al Harrison questions if giving Katherine Goble access to unredacted information is a good idea.
Al Harrison decides the unredacted documents should be printed with darker ink.
Al Harrison asks Ruth to pass along his instructions for darker ink.

youtube_description: The incredible untold true story of Katherine Johnson (Taraji P. Henson), Dorothy Vaughan (Octavia Spencer) & Mary Jackson (Janelle Monae)—brilliant African-American women working at NASA, who served as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history: the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit. This stunning achievement galvanized the world and inspired generations to dream big.
